body: NHRS Roofing is a top Houston roofing contractor for new turnkey roof installs on single homes, multi-family housing units, office buildings and entire communities.

Free inspection and estimate before any work

services.title: Roof Repair
services.short: Leaks, old age and storm damage, repaired.
services.text: Each year we repair many Houston roofs due to old age, deterioration, leaks, and damage from hail, wind, storms and hurricanes.
services.imageAlt: A shingle roof with water staining along a wall where a leak had been running

If your roof is leaking, we offer a free, no-obligation inspection and, if it is needed, a repair or replacement estimate for your Houston home or business.
points: Repairs for hail, wind and hurricane damage
Repairs to older and deteriorating roofs

services.short: Hail, hurricane, tornado and wind damage.

services.title: Commercial Roofing
services.short: Office buildings, multi-family and businesses of every size.
services.text: Installs, re-roofing, repairs, metal roofing and tear-offs for Houston businesses, organizations and non-profits, including office buildings and multi-family housing.
services.imageAlt: An aerial view of a long low-slope shingle roof over a commercial building
body: NHRS Roofing offers a full line of commercial roofing services and solutions for Houston-area businesses, organizations and non-profits. From a simple roof leak repair to a full tear-off or a new roof install on a multi-family development, our commercial department gives an extra level of attention and detail.

Over the past 25 years and more, NHRS Roofing has repaired or replaced hundreds of commercial roofs for businesses all over the Houston area. Our in-house commercial roofing professionals have gained the trust of Houston businesses from The Woodlands to Galveston, and from Katy to Beaumont. We know how to get the job done right the first time, on-budget and on-time.

We are a leader in the Houston area when it comes to roofing for commercial office buildings, and over the past 25 years and more we have completed scores of roofing projects for commercial multi-family housing units.
We are also one of the few roofing contractors in Houston that travel the entire state of Texas for larger-scale commercial roofing projects.

faqs.q: Do you travel outside Houston for commercial work?
faqs.a: Yes. We are one of the few roofing contractors in Houston that travel the entire state of Texas for larger-scale commercial roofing projects.

services.text: A residential and commercial roof maintenance program aimed at reducing the overall cost of roof maintenance and improving how long a roof lasts.
services.imageAlt: A close view of a new gray architectural shingle roof at a valley
body: NHRS Roofing offers both residential and commercial roofing maintenance solutions aimed at reducing the overall cost of roof maintenance while improving roof longevity and its useful life over time.
An NHRS Roofing Commercial Roof Maintenance Plan reduces the overall cost of roof maintenance and improves the reliability of roof performance and longevity.

services.title: Energy-Saving Solutions
services.short: Solar-powered ventilation and other energy savings.
services.text: Energy-saving solutions for homes and businesses, including solar-powered roof ventilation that cuts cooling costs.
services.imageAlt: An aerial view over a patio and a new shingle roof section on a Pearland home
body: We provide a variety of energy-saving solutions for Houston homeowners and businesses looking to reduce their power bill, add value to their property and reduce their carbon footprint.
That includes residential and commercial solar-powered roof ventilation, which reduces cooling costs significantly.

services.title: Lighting Solutions
services.text: Lighting solutions for homes and businesses, including skylights that bring natural light into a space while reducing the power bill.
body: NHRS Roofing offers intuitive lighting solutions for Houston homes and businesses that include, but are not limited to, skylights that bring natural light into your space while reducing your power bill.
On a commercial building, commercial skylights cut overall lighting costs while bringing in natural light.

about.title: A Houston roofing contractor you can trust and rely on
text: NHRS Roofing is one of the top-rated roofing contractors in the Houston area. If your Houston home or business needs a new roof or just a simple repair, look no further than New Horizons Roofing Specialists.
We are owned and operated by a local Houston family, and we put relationship building and customer service ahead of anything else. That is one of the reasons we hold an A+ rating with the BBB.

Over the past 25 years and more our line of roofing services has expanded across residential and commercial work, from new roof installs and repairs to large-scale tear-offs, metal roofing, and fascia and soffit. We have successfully completed thousands of residential and commercial roofing projects throughout the Houston area.
about.imageAlt: An NHRS Roofing crew installing a new roof over exposed underlayment on a Houston home
